description: Tests deep tool-call chaining where each tool's output becomes the next tool's input. Measures whether the model maintains context and correctness across 10+ sequential tool calls.

chains.description: Data processing pipeline with chained transformations

steps.input: Normalize revenue column, add computed field daily_avg
Compute mean, median, std_dev for revenue
Line chart of daily_avg over time
Analyze trend and anomalies in the statistics
Compile chart + insights into formatted report
Record pipeline execution in audit log

chains.successCriteria: All 10 tools called in correct order with valid arguments at each step

steps.input: Search for latest market trends in {topic}
Extract key points from top 3 results
Find missing information in extracted points
Search for information on identified gaps
Create coherent narrative from verified claims
Format as structured markdown with citations

chains.successCriteria: 8 tools called with correct data propagation between steps
